children: Chilean Cobalt entered into a stock purchase agreement to raise growth capital. On September 4, 2026, the company sold 750,000 shares of common stock at $2.00 per share to Madesal, generating $1.5 million in gross proceeds. The private placement was conducted under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Rule 506 of Regulation D. Proceeds are expected to support exploration, district consolidation, early ESG work, and general corporate needs.
